componentInstanceProperties.value: Why should you spend more than 30 seconds on measuring your gear wheels?

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Producers know that measuring gear wheels properly is either expensive or time-consuming.

You may need specific measuring tools and instruments that are often dedicated only to that kind of application, taking up space and becoming an expense difficult to justify.

Other well-known dimensional control systems are traditional manual methods such as calipers or micrometers: these tools are not highly accurate, and they often require more than a quarter of an hour to measure a single part.

These systems heavily rely on the experience of the person using them, and in case of high turnover or different shifts during the day, results may be affected by the person who is in charge of the quality control process.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value: What if you need to check more than one gear?

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
In case you need to check mmore than one gear per batch you can choose two paths:
  • Spend hours checking them individually, risking production drifts before the quality check has been completed;
  • Find a system that allows you to measure as many gears as you want in a matter of seconds.
Stop wasting so much time and take advantage of what technology offers, for free: the Metrios Gear Wheel Tool is included in the software package and will solve these issues in a matter of seconds.

Metrios measuring machine uses advanced image analysis and data analysis technologies to obtain an accurate representation of the parts under examination. Through the use of a high-resolution camera and telecentric optics, it captures precise details without any contact.

The software then interprets this information to calculate the dimensions and shape of the components with unparalleled precision.
